text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer.
To the battlefield we go!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Heading into the great battle to determine the best in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: His departing figure looked more dependable than ever before, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, she looked sorrowful.
I felt a sudden pang that I might never see
her back again.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, hear ye, for I am No Reason!
The one who forever clings to the dream of usurping the throne!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Everyone, come forth!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if prompted by No Reason,
the racing Umamusume lined up in a neat row.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: My only goal—is victory.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready to be sunk?
Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: (Lady Kris S, Lady Tap, Lady Universe... everything up to this point is within expectations. However—)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: The issue――is the next one.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The renowned Umamusume are all here!
And right now, fiercely chasing down her classmate Neo Universe is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy!
The girl who once only dreamed of heroes
has now become a magnificent hero candidate herself!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(Guh... this pressure...
My back is... tingling...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(To think it would come to this...
I suppose my time is finally up.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, No Reason-san.
If there is such a tome called history...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I, too, wish to inscribe an immortal chapter
into a corner of that history."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, tucked in a corner, is it?
Quite the words you have for me.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Enough with the modesty.
Thou art no longer a mere foot soldier. Thou art, without question—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A “Great Warlord,” she is.
Perhaps the greatest among all of us here.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If you think so—it is an honor.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(...Truly, the Silent Clan is terrifying.
Not just Universe-dono, but...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(They just keep churning out powerful new contenders one after another.
And next year, and the year after that as well...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Can I really... win it...?
Even if my reign lasts only three days...?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Against this lineup...?
Or maybe... even that is no longer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A waning fighting spirit...
The flame of life—flickering.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I shouted with all my might—
my voice didn't seem to reach them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I'll be overwhelmed.
I'll be completely swallowed up.
Just at that moment—"
—Kuhahaha! The time of my descent... has come at last.

"The appointed hour is now.
If the gates of the final war are to open—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us brandish our shining blade.
For the sake of the next genesis!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? You're—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lord Gimlet!
To think you would truly appear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The one who appeared was Tanino Gimlet, who had been resting since last year's Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, sentimentality toward ruin is sweet indeed.
Yet the path to the divine realm is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Conflict, conflict, and yet more conflict!
Only the destruction at its end shines for eternity!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I――have come here.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Even if you do not do it—I will.
I shall build tomorrow with the remnants of my longing.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Lord Gimlet...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I... see... You...
certainly have guts, don't you?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Are you saying you'll fight to the bitter end and win?
Even against this opponent?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufufufu... A truly remarkable one, as expected.
That woke me right up. —All right!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Together, we can stand up to it!
Let us do this, you and I...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...No, wait a moment.
I was being a bit faint-hearted, wasn't I?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, long ago, you and I
clashed in battle to decide the sole victor!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: This surging blood... It reminds me. That's right, there can only be one to conquer the realm!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: You too are one of the enemy warlords!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, it is already decided.
You are an offering. Nothing more than a sacrifice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fleeting thought of fighting side-by-side vanished like a bubble.
Generals are not meant to stand together, but to clash.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—I have chattered far too much.
Shall we begin, then?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What becomes of future generations matters not to me.
For the one who rules the era of "now" is—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: It's ME, I tell yaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Tanino Gimlet's appearance,
No Reason seemed to catch his second wind.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone. A reprise of the Satsuki Sho
that left everyone breathless!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
My name is No Reason!
Even if I am but a transient blossom—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: The greatest fleeting bloom of the era!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now, toward that final—and reasonless victory.
